svg.title: Hardness conversion chart HRC HV HBW tensile strength
svg.text: Hardness conversion – read across: HV ↔ HRC ↔ HBW ↔ approximate tensile strength Rm (unalloyed and low-alloy steels)
Values of table §4.8 (ISO 18265 / ASTM E140 style). Approximate (± 5 – 10 %). For acceptance test with the scale written on the drawing.
550 HV = limit for case depth CHD (ISO 18203)
How to use: put a ruler horizontally across
the four scales at your known value.
Not valid for: cast iron, aluminium, bronze,
(surface ≠ core). Use the scale and load of
